video_title: LeBron to Philly EXPLAINED 👀 Dave McMenamin Breaks His Silence - D'Marco & Travis

quotes.speaker: Dave McMenamin
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James decided on his free agency destination before today
quotes.excerpt: he had decided prior to today. I'm not sure how long that means
quotes.quote: I was told that he had decided prior to today. I'm not sure how long that means, but the person I spoke to said the last couple days. Sometime this week is probably a safe bet. Listen, he did tell everybody. I was in New York for Fanatics Fest last week, he told everybody, I'm not going to make you wait that much longer. There is some level of responsibility in a league partner allowing Adam Silver to go about the business of filling out a 1,240-game schedule with all sorts of national television permutations.

quotes.speaker: Dave McMenamin
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James's free agency decision involved family and other teams
quotes.excerpt: you have to go through certain things in terms of making sure everyone in your family
quotes.quote: I was told that within the last couple days, let's say he came to the conclusion on Wednesday. Then I think you have to go through certain things in terms of making sure everyone in your family is okay with it, probably Rich Paul having some calls with other teams involved.

quotes.speaker: Dave McMenamin
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James's free agency list included Cleveland, Miami, and Philly
quotes.excerpt: the teams that we continue to report on, they were all presented as realistic scenarios
quotes.quote: The teams that we continue to report on, they were all presented as realistic scenarios. I stopped saying Minnesota, I stopped saying Denver about a week ago or ten days ago because I was told they'd fallen off. Was it Golden State, Cleveland, Miami, and Philly? Correct. Shams, giving him credit, he had put Golden State kind of fourth, and in LeBron's string of tweets today after the announcement, he didn't mention Golden State. He acknowledges Cleveland and Miami as places he was considering, so I think that's pretty good reporting from Shams to suggest that Golden State was actually the fourth option.

quotes.speaker: Dave McMenamin
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James felt his time with the Lakers had run its course
quotes.excerpt: a source familiar with LeBron's thinking just told me he just thought it was time
quotes.quote: I reported at the time, shortly after Rich Paul informed the Lakers LeBron would be moving on, that a source familiar with LeBron's thinking just told me he just thought it was time. It ran its course. Could some moves have been made from the moment the Lakers traded for Luka Doncic until that point that would have perhaps not led to him having that feeling it was time? I think so, yes. And I think the Lakers would say it goes both ways. It wasn't like either side was a perfect partner in this marriage they had for eight years.

quotes.speaker: Dave McMenamin
quotes.summary_phrase: Lakers could have been a better team with LeBron James
quotes.excerpt: I think there's some level of, man, this should have been easier to figure out
quotes.quote: I think there's some level of, man, this should have been easier to figure out because I think the Lakers could have been a very, very good team again with LeBron James on it. Not to say that they won't be a very good team next year, I think there's reason to be optimistic about this group, but I think certainly you'd be more optimistic about this group with LeBron taking one of the minimum spots.

quotes.speaker: Dave McMenamin
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James's decision to join the Sixers was not just basketball
quotes.excerpt: had the Knicks not won the championship, LeBron James would be on the Knicks
quotes.quote: Rich Paul announced a week ago or so that had the Knicks not won the championship, LeBron James would be on the Knicks. It was an easy decision. Well, why would that be? Because he'd live in New York. There's a very good chance he lives in New York and plays for the Sixers. So he can still have that part of things, and that's not just the basketball decision, obviously.

quotes.speaker: Dave McMenamin
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James's goal to become a global icon requires bold moves
quotes.excerpt: the only way you achieve a status like that is to make bold moves like this
quotes.quote: LeBron at a very young age made it known, I think it was an ESPN The Magazine article, where he said on the record, I don't just want to be a basketball player, I want to be a global icon. The only way you achieve a status like that is to make bold moves like this and go from market to market and continue to be in the conversation as an intriguing figure. It's what we've seen from Madonna changing up her look and changing up the style of music, Beyonce doing a country album when we've known who Beyonce is for 20 years. Here, you're going to see me in a different light now. It's what you need to do to stay a famous relevant person.

quotes.speaker: Dave McMenamin
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James's potential future in international basketball
quotes.excerpt: if he's going to play 25 years, and then maybe finish out in 2028 in the NBA
quotes.quote: If he's going to play 25 years, and then maybe finish out in 2028 in the NBA with the Olympics in Los Angeles against international competition, who knows? That wouldn't be a terrible way to go into the sunset. There was some discussion about that last summer, he was famously photographed on a boat with Nikola Jokic's agent. There was some talk about Maverick Carter being interested in starting a rival to the EuroLeague. I don't think it would be Saudi money necessarily, but certainly it would be an equivalent to that.

quotes.speaker: Dave McMenamin
quotes.summary_phrase: Dave McMenamin's reporting process on the LeBron James story
quotes.excerpt: I pre-wrote a story for those four teams I had mentioned, including reporting with all those scenarios
quotes.quote: I pre-wrote a story for those four teams I had mentioned, including reporting with all those scenarios because I was having conversations and all that reporting in each of those four stories would be applicable if he chose them. And so that was a big responsibility of mine. I did a story about Joel Embiid, Tyrese Maxey, Jaylen Brown still pursuing LeBron two weeks into the thing. I'm the one who wrote that. Now, Shams Charania, who is our number one news breaker in the NBA, that's his role, and I'm very happy and pleased and I worked great with him.

quotes.speaker: Dave McMenamin
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James understands the adjustment period with new teammates
quotes.excerpt: he knows it's going to be adjustment. They were what, 10 and 9 to start off the
quotes.quote: I think the beauty of LeBron having been through everything so far in this league is that he knows it's going to be adjustment. They were what, 10 and 9 to start off the Heatles era. They were 19 and 20 his first year back in Cleveland in 14-15. 18-19, we saw what that the mess that season was for the Lakers. So he recognizes, he's not afraid of the fact that there's going to be a time where it feels uncomfortable.

quotes.speaker: Dave McMenamin
quotes.summary_phrase: The benefit of playing on a LeBron James team
quotes.excerpt: you feel so much pressure during the regular season that by the time you get to
quotes.quote: The great part about playing on a LeBron James team is that you feel so much pressure during the regular season that by the time you get to the playoffs, you have faced more adversity than pretty much any other team in the league. And it does steal that group, especially if they can come together, that they feel like anything's possible.

quotes.speaker: Dave McMenamin
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James informed the Lakers he wanted to compete for a championship
quotes.excerpt: Luka has basically informed the Lakers that he wanted to be competing for a championship yesterday
quotes.quote: I reported about a month ago that a source close to Luka familiar with his thinking said that Luka has basically informed the Lakers that he wanted to be competing for a championship yesterday. So then if that is your directive to the team that you're playing for, you got to hold up your end of the bargain. He said, I reported, get me an A-list center. They completely emptied out their cupboard of assets, excuse me, and got Walker Kessler. He has to make Walker Kessler look like an All-Star and they need to perform.

quotes.speaker: Dave McMenamin
quotes.summary_phrase: Lakers' value proposition in acquiring Mo Bamba and others
quotes.excerpt: they saw a value proposition with Mo Bamba. They saw a guy that perhaps was not utilized
quotes.quote: They saw a value proposition with Mo Bamba. They saw a guy that perhaps was not utilized to the full lengths of his abilities in Quentin Grimes and has connections to Luka and JJ. Obviously a guy who competes in Colin Sexton, etc. However, I've been told this opinion by various people around the league, something that could be their ceiling is have they a bunch of players that are slotted maybe one spot above where they would be on a natural pecking order of a championship roster.

quotes.speaker: Dave McMenamin
quotes.summary_phrase: The Eastern Conference is tougher than the West top-to-bottom
quotes.excerpt: the East is tougher one through eight. I still think the West is tougher top heavy
quotes.quote: The East is tougher one through eight. I still think the West is tougher top heavy. It was termed to me at one point when LeBron was going through his decision-making process and why it seemed like the Eastern Conference would be the more likely destination for him. In the West, you got to play two NBA Finals before you get to the Finals in San Antonio and OKC.

quotes.speaker: Dave McMenamin
quotes.summary_phrase: Dave McMenamin's Eastern Conference power rankings
quotes.excerpt: you got to go Knicks one. I think Boston is still very. I don't think Philly
quotes.quote: You got to go Knicks one. I think Boston is still very. I don't think Philly, even with Jaylen Brown gone. I mean, Indiana is back at least. Indiana is intriguing to me for them to all of a sudden, I would probably put Philly in the four to five range because you have to account for. I know there's Detroit, but we don't know yet. Detroit, Detroit there for sure. I think Detroit is right there. I don't know. I have to see them first for me. Miami, they still only have 12 players on their team right now. So like there was final three spots. Is it Bradley Beal and DeMar DeRozan, etc., to talk yourself into it, or are you like, they still got a lot of work to do?

quotes.speaker: Dave McMenamin
quotes.summary_phrase: Kawhi Leonard's potential free agency and team fit
quotes.excerpt: what if Kawhi, the deal is rescinded, his contract is voided, and he jumps on one of
quotes.quote: What if Kawhi, the deal is rescinded, his contract is voided, and he jumps on one of these other teams we're talking about? We don't know that. We don't have a guarantee he's going to end up in Toronto, we don't know that.
